items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: 1942 listed the rest of the personnel as Earl Willis (piano), Buddy Harper (guitar), Ted Brinson (string bass) and Willis McDaniels (drums)."

ctx.x: It says, uh...piano...uh... Paul Howard fronted a group, and he was on tenor saxophone. It says, "Down Beat of 1st of November 1942 listed the rest of the personnel as Earl Willis (piano), Buddy Harper (guitar), Ted Brinson (string bass) and Willis McDaniels (drums)."

Ted Brinson has got a recording studio. He's a mailman in here--he's been for twenty, twenty-five years, but he's got a recording studio that he does, you know, in his spare time at Fifth Avenue and Washington upstairs there. He's been up there twenty, twenty-some years. Ted Brinson. But he's a mailman around in this district.
